_comment: BUSINESS-NEUTRAL Hermes detection library. It holds NO business rules. It only describes how to RECOGNISE a category of tool call in Hermes (the engine-specific bit that can't live in an engine-neutral model). The actual rules — which limits exist, tiers, approvers, caps — are read LIVE from your model's Governance layer at runtime. A detector is attached to a Governance hard limit (or approve-tier action) when that rule's text contains the detector's keywords. Edit your Governance Markdown to change rules; edit THIS only to teach Hermes new tool-call shapes. Patterns are regex, matched case-insensitively against the tool NAME (tool_patterns) and the JSON-serialised ARGS (arg_patterns).
